Name: Fairy Mushroom Tree
Author: lumiepop
Description:
Gives the mushroom tree a more realistic and magical appearance.

There are 2 color schemes: to change them, open config.json and replace to either "bright" or "dull". 
Bright matches the vanilla colors best and dull matches lots of toned-down recolors. I use "dull" in the screenshot provided.

Please ask permission to use my assets anywhere else. 


An AT version of this mod has been made and added various other color variations. Thanks to jmherbert513 for creating it.
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13496?tab=description

Hope you enjoy!
